description: End-to-end consuming-model gate (the bootstrap plan's final check): a scratch heat model importing grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D2_zero_grad_bc.esm with the edge binding N=64 — production resolution, the library consumed exactly as a downstream model consumes it. Every binding loads fixture.esm, runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint over the whole document (equations, the coordinate-expression ic, and the section-6.6.5 inline-test references written over the grid's x_coord geometry template), and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,x),x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior [2,63]; ghost-eliminated zero-gradient faces at i=1 and i=64), every apply_expression_template inlined (including inside tests), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names. The unstructured-grid half of the same gate is ast/fv_divergence_cell (the MPAS fv_divergence_cell rule consumed by a scratch model), byte-compared by the same five runners. Simulation-capable bindings additionally execute the fixture's inline MMS test through their official pathway (verified by the julia/python runners; see the simulation manifests for the rust blocked-upstream note). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
